title: Spicy Poblano Fajitas
description: A flavorful and spicy dish featuring sautéed poblanos and your choice of protein, served with warm flour tortillas.

ingredients.name: 1/2 cup lovely crunchy sliced bell peppers

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced onion and bell peppers to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the roasted poblanos, garlic, and fajita seasoning to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Warm the flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the fajitas by placing a portion of the chicken and vegetable mixture onto a tortilla and serving with sour cream and cilantro if desired.
Optional: Serve with additional toppings such as diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, or sliced avocado.
